title: 1945년이후종전의규정에의한학교졸업자자격인정령 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
full_text: Article 1 A person who, as of May 31, had completed the third grade of a lower middle school or the third grade of a middle school under the former provisions shall be recognized as having qualifications equivalent to those of a person who has completed the third grade of a middle school under the Education Act.
